summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing daily open-market repurchases under its buy-back programme launched 28 October 2026. On 5 November 2026 it bought 170,000 ordinary shares on UK Venues at a volume-weighted average of US$13.1762 (range US$12.8640–13.3800) and 46,800 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$139.6436. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 4,049,461 shares for approximately US$69.8m, executed by Goldman Sachs International and cancelled; issued capital stands at 17,134,040,846 shares with no treasury holdings. Watch execution pace and daily cancellation updates.
